name: mhc_pre_hidden_size7168
description: Mix four residual streams into an optionally rms-normed layer input; derive the post mixes.

proj_weight.description: Projects the flattened streams to 24 mix logits.

mix_scale.description: Scale of the pre, post and combination logits.

rms_eps.description: Added to the mean square of the streams.

pre_eps.description: Added to each pre mix after its sigmoid.

post_multiplier.description: Multiplies each post mix after its sigmoid.

sinkhorn_iters.description: Sinkhorn normalizations of the combination mix.

norm_eps.description: Added to the mean square of layer_input.

post_mix.description: Post mix of the next mHC post.

comb_mix.description: Combination mix of the next mHC post.

layer_input.description: The streams summed under the pre mix.

sources.content:
"""FlyDSL mHC pre without a norm weight: a matrix-core split-K projection of the residual onto the mix rows,
then one wave per (token, hidden block) that folds the partials into the gates, Sinkhorn and ``layer_input``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import functools

import flydsl.compiler as flyc
import flydsl.expr as fx
import torch
from flydsl._mlir import ir as _ir
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import llvm as _llvm

S = 4
D = 7168
P = S * D
M = 2 * S + S * S  # pre, post and comb mixes
NPART = 32  # the M mixes and the sum of squares, padded
WAVE = 64
TILE = 16  # MFMA M and N
KSTEP = 32  # MFMA K
_LOAD_BITS = 128
VEC = _LOAD_BITS // fx.BFloat16.width  # bf16 per load
_LOG2E = 1.4426950408889634


def _f32(v):
    return fx.Float32(v)


def _rcp(x):
    return fx.Float32(fx.rocdl.rcp(_ir.F32Type.get(), fx.as_ir_value(x)))


def _rsq(x):
    return fx.Float32(fx.rocdl.rsq(_ir.F32Type.get(), fx.as_ir_value(x)))


def _exp(x):
    return fx.Float32(fx.rocdl.exp2(_ir.F32Type.get(), fx.as_ir_value(x * _f32(_LOG2E))))


def _sigmoid(z):
    return _rcp(_f32(1.0) + _exp(_f32(0.0) - z))


def _permute_pair(a, b, offset):
    op = fx.rocdl.permlane16_swap if offset == 16 else fx.rocdl.permlane32_swap
    ai = fx.Float32(a).bitcast(fx.Int32).ir_value()
    bi = fx.Float32(b).bitcast(fx.Int32).ir_value()
    pair = op(_ir.Type.parse("!llvm.struct<(i32, i32)>"), ai, bi, False, True)
    return [
        fx.Int32(_llvm.ExtractValueOp(fx.Int32.ir_type, pair, [i]).result).bitcast(fx.Float32)
        for i in range(2)
    ]


def _fixed_shuffle(v, offset):
    lo, hi = _permute_pair(v, v, offset)
    return ((fx.thread_idx.x & offset) != 0).select(lo, hi)


def _scatter(vals, offset):
    h = (len(vals) + 1) // 2
    hi = vals[h:] + [_f32(0.0)] * (2 * h - len(vals))
    out = []
    for lo_k, hi_k in zip(vals[:h], hi):
        a, b = _permute_pair(lo_k, hi_k, offset)
        out.append(a + b)
    return out


def _gather(vals, offset, n_orig):
    pairs = [_permute_pair(v, v, offset) for v in vals]
    return ([p[0] for p in pairs] + [p[1] for p in pairs])[:n_orig]


_DPP_XOR1 = 0xB1  # quad_perm [1,0,3,2]
_DPP_XOR2 = 0x4E  # quad_perm [2,3,0,1]
_DPP_ROR4 = 0x124  # row_ror:4
_DPP_ROR8 = 0x128  # row_ror:8
_DPP_HMIRROR = 0x141  # row_half_mirror


def _dpp(v, ctrl):
    return fx.Float32(
        fx.rocdl.update_dpp(_ir.F32Type.get(), fx.as_ir_value(v), fx.as_ir_value(v), ctrl, 0xF, 0xF, True)
    )


def _reduce_all(vals):
    """Wave reduction in a fixed order; every lane ends with every sum."""
    sizes = []
    for offset in (32, 16):
        sizes.append(len(vals))
        vals = _scatter(vals, offset)
    for ctrl in (_DPP_XOR1, _DPP_XOR2, _DPP_HMIRROR, _DPP_ROR8):
        vals = [v + _dpp(v, ctrl) for v in vals]
    for offset, n in zip((16, 32), reversed(sizes)):
        vals = _gather(vals, offset, n)
    return vals


def _sinkhorn_lane(vals, rms, s2, mbv, L, eps, iters):
    """Sinkhorn on the S x S comb matrix; lane ``L`` of a DPP row holds entry (L // S, L % S)."""
    v = list(vals)
    for b in range(len(v).bit_length() - 1):
        up = (L & (1 << b)) != 0
        v = [up.select(v[2 * m + 1], v[2 * m]) for m in range(len(v) // 2)]
    z = v[0] * rms * s2 + mbv
    mx = fx.max(z, _dpp(z, _DPP_XOR1))
    mx = fx.max(mx, _dpp(mx, _DPP_XOR2))
    e = _exp(z - mx)
    tot = e + _dpp(e, _DPP_XOR1)
    tot = tot + _dpp(tot, _DPP_XOR2)
    c = e * _rcp(tot) + eps

    def col(c):
        cs = c + _dpp(c, _DPP_ROR4)
        cs = cs + _dpp(cs, _DPP_ROR8)
        return c * _rcp(cs + eps)

    def row(c):
        rs = c + _dpp(c, _DPP_XOR1)
        rs = rs + _dpp(rs, _DPP_XOR2)
        return c * _rcp(rs + eps)

    c = col(c)
    for _ in range(iters - 1):
        c = col(row(c))
    return c


def _load_vec(tensor, offset, size, dtype):
    n = _LOAD_BITS // dtype.width
    if size > n:
        lo = _load_vec(tensor, offset, n, dtype)
        hi = _load_vec(tensor, offset + n, size - n, dtype)
        return fx.Vector.from_elements(
            [lo[e] for e in range(n)] + [hi[e] for e in range(size - n)], dtype=dtype
        )
    ty = _ir.VectorType.get([size], dtype.ir_type)
    return fx.Vector(fx.ptr_load(fx.get_iter(tensor) + offset, result_type=ty), (size,), dtype)


def _store_vec(tensor, offset, value):
    fx.ptr_store(fx.as_ir_value(value), fx.get_iter(tensor) + offset)


def _buffer_view(tensor, shape):
    row_major = tuple(range(len(shape) - 1, -1, -1))
    view = fx.make_view(fx.get_iter(tensor), fx.make_ordered_layout(shape, row_major))
    return fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(view)


def _tok(T, base, idx):
    if T < TILE:
        return idx % T
    return base + idx


def _config(T):
    """(K slices of k_part, hidden blocks of k_fin) for ``T`` tokens."""
    if T <= 32:
        return 224, 14
    if T <= 64:
        return 224, 7
    return 128, 2


def _make(T, NK, NHB, rms_eps, pre_eps, sk_eps, post_mult, iters):
    NT = (T + TILE - 1) // TILE
    KW = P // NK
    STEPS = KW // KSTEP
    assert KW % KSTEP == 0
    KL = KSTEP * TILE // WAVE  # K elements per lane per MFMA
    ACC = TILE * TILE // WAVE  # accumulator rows per lane
    HB = D // NHB
    FIT = HB // (WAVE * VEC)
    assert FIT >= 1 and HB % (WAVE * VEC) == 0
    NU = (NK + WAVE - 1) // WAVE

    @flyc.kernel
    def k_part(res: fx.Tensor, w: fx.Tensor, part: fx.Tensor):
        res = _buffer_view(res, (T, P))
        w = _buffer_view(w, (M, P))
        part = _buffer_view(part, (T, NK, NPART))
        acc_ty = _ir.VectorType.get([ACC], _ir.F32Type.get())
        lane = fx.thread_idx.x
        r = lane % TILE
        q = lane // TILE
        ks = fx.block_idx.x
        tb = fx.block_idx.y
        tok = _tok(T, tb * TILE, r)
        m1 = TILE + r % (M - TILE)
        k0 = ks * KW + q * KL

        avs = []
        w0s = []
        w1s = []
        for c in fx.range_constexpr(STEPS):
            k = k0 + c * KSTEP
            avs.append(_load_vec(res, tok * P + k, KL, fx.BFloat16))
            w0s.append(_load_vec(w, r * P + k, KL, fx.Float32))
            w1s.append(_load_vec(w, m1 * P + k, KL, fx.Float32))
        zero = fx.Vector.from_elements([_f32(0.0)] * ACC, dtype=fx.Float32)
        acc0 = zero
        acc1 = zero
        sq = _f32(0.0)
        for c in fx.range_constexpr(STEPS):
            av = avs[c]
            for n in fx.range_constexpr(2):
                # A bf16 high part plus a bf16 remainder of the fp32 weight keeps fp32-level accuracy.
                wvv = w0s[c] if n == 0 else w1s[c]
                whi = wvv.to(fx.BFloat16)
                wlo = (wvv - whi.to(fx.Float32)).to(fx.BFloat16)
                a = acc0 if n == 0 else acc1
                a = fx.rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16(acc_ty, [av, whi, a, 0, 0, 0])
                a = fx.rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16(acc_ty, [av, wlo, a, 0, 0, 0])
                if n == 0:
                    acc0 = a
                else:
                    acc1 = a
            af = av.to(fx.Float32)
            for e in fx.range_constexpr(KL):
                sq = fx.math.fma(af[e], af[e], sq)
        sq = sq + _fixed_shuffle(sq, TILE)
        sq = sq + _fixed_shuffle(sq, 2 * TILE)
        cv0 = fx.Vector(acc0, (ACC,), fx.Float32)
        cv1 = fx.Vector(acc1, (ACC,), fx.Float32)
        tts = [_tok(T, tb * TILE, q * ACC + i) for i in range(ACC)]
        for i in fx.range_constexpr(ACC):
            part[tts[i], ks, r] = cv0[i]
        if r < M - TILE:
            for i in fx.range_constexpr(ACC):
                part[tts[i], ks, TILE + r] = cv1[i]
        if q == 0:
            part[tok, ks, M] = sq

    @flyc.kernel
    def k_fin(
        part: fx.Tensor,
        res: fx.Tensor,
        ms: fx.Tensor,
        mb: fx.Tensor,
        opost: fx.Tensor,
        ocomb: fx.Tensor,
        oli: fx.Tensor,
    ):
        part = _buffer_view(part, (T, NK, NPART))
        res = _buffer_view(res, (T, P))
        ms = _buffer_view(ms, (3,))
        mb = _buffer_view(mb, (M,))
        opost = _buffer_view(opost, (T, S))
        ocomb = _buffer_view(ocomb, (T, S * S))
        oli = _buffer_view(oli, (T, D))
        lane = fx.thread_idx.x
        t = fx.block_idx.x
        hb = fx.block_idx.y
        L = lane % (S * S)
        hs = [hb * HB + k * (WAVE * VEC) + lane * VEC for k in range(FIT)]
        # Residual loads go first so they are in flight during the reduction.
        rv = [[_load_vec(res, t * P + j * D + hs[k], VEC, fx.BFloat16) for j in range(S)] for k in range(FIT)]
        # Lane holds K slices lane, lane + WAVE, ...
        nv = _LOAD_BITS // fx.Float32.width
        rows = []
        for u in fx.range_constexpr(NU):
            kk = lane + u * WAVE
            kc = kk if NK % WAVE == 0 else (kk < NK).select(kk, 0)
            vv = []
            for g in fx.range_constexpr((M + nv) // nv):
                vec = _load_vec(part, (t * NK + kc) * NPART + g * nv, nv, fx.Float32)
                vv.extend([vec[e] for e in range(nv)])
            vv = vv[: M + 1]
            vv = vv if NK % WAVE == 0 else [(kk < NK).select(x, _f32(0.0)) for x in vv]
            rows.append(vv)
        s0 = fx.Float32(ms[0])
        mbp = [fx.Float32(mb[a]) for a in range(S)]
        vals = rows[0]
        for u in fx.range_constexpr(NU - 1):
            vals = [vals[j] + rows[u + 1][j] for j in range(M + 1)]
        red = _reduce_all(vals)
        rms = _rsq(red[M] * _f32(1.0 / float(P)) + _f32(rms_eps))
        pre = [_sigmoid(red[a] * rms * s0 + mbp[a]) + _f32(pre_eps) for a in range(S)]
        for k in fx.range_constexpr(FIT):
            fs = [rv[k][j].to(fx.Float32) for j in range(S)]
            acc = fs[0] * fx.Vector.from_elements([pre[0]] * VEC, dtype=fx.Float32)
            for j in fx.range_constexpr(S - 1):
                acc = fx.Vector(
                    fx.math.fma(
                        fs[j + 1], fx.Vector.from_elements([pre[j + 1]] * VEC, dtype=fx.Float32), acc
                    ),
                    (VEC,),
                    fx.Float32,
                )
            _store_vec(oli, t * D + hs[k], acc.to(fx.BFloat16))
        if hb == 0:
            s1 = fx.Float32(ms[1])
            s2 = fx.Float32(ms[2])
            mbv = fx.Float32(mb[2 * S + L])
            cl = _sinkhorn_lane([red[2 * S + k] for k in range(S * S)], rms, s2, mbv, L, _f32(sk_eps), iters)
            if lane < S * S:
                ocomb[t, L] = cl
            pz = red[S]
            for j in fx.range_constexpr(S - 1):
                pz = (L == j + 1).select(red[S + j + 1], pz)
            mbq = fx.Float32(mb[S + L % S])
            if lane < S:
                opost[t, L] = _sigmoid(pz * rms * s1 + mbq) * _f32(post_mult)

    @flyc.jit
    def launch(
        res: fx.Tensor,
        w: fx.Tensor,
        ms: fx.Tensor,
        mb: fx.Tensor,
        part: fx.Tensor,
        opost: fx.Tensor,
        ocomb: fx.Tensor,
        oli: fx.Tensor,
        stream: fx.Stream,
    ):
        k_part(res, w, part).launch(grid=(NK, NT, 1), block=(WAVE, 1, 1), stream=stream)
        k_fin(part, res, ms, mb, opost, ocomb, oli).launch(
            grid=(T, NHB, 1), block=(WAVE, 1, 1), stream=stream
        )

    return launch, NK


@functools.cache
def _compiled(T, rms_eps, pre_eps, sk_eps, post_mult, iters):
    return _make(T, *_config(T), rms_eps, pre_eps, sk_eps, post_mult, iters)


def run(
    *,
    residual,
    proj_weight,
    mix_scale,
    mix_bias,
    rms_eps,
    pre_eps,
    sinkhorn_eps,
    post_multiplier,
    sinkhorn_iters,
    norm_weight,
    norm_eps,
    post_mix,
    comb_mix,
    layer_input,
):
    """Write post_mix, comb_mix and layer_input of the mHC pre for ``residual``."""
    T = int(residual.shape[0])
    launch, NK = _compiled(
        T, float(rms_eps), float(pre_eps), float(sinkhorn_eps), float(post_multiplier), int(sinkhorn_iters)
    )
    part = torch.empty((T, NK, NPART), dtype=torch.float32, device=residual.device)
    launch(
        residual,
        proj_weight,
        mix_scale,
        mix_bias,
        part,
        post_mix,
        comb_mix,
        layer_input,
        fx.Stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(residual.device).cuda_stream),
    )
